summary_claims.claim: Forbids delegating decisions to AI, fully automating processes affecting fundamental rights, and determining guilt or innocence
Wholly opaque systems are banned; use of generative AI to draft texts must be disclosed

note: The Court's PDF (OCR text layer, garbled in places) supports resolution number, 4 Mar 2026 date, authorisation of the policy and the summarised rules. No amendment found; the Court's own notices of Apr 2026 describe the same policy.
